title: ArchCustomWidgets unit manifest
description: Manifest contract for a widget or service unit in the ArchCustomWidgets factory.

type.description: Unit kind: widget (waybar module, standalone widget) or service (systemd user unit).

description.description: One-line description of what the unit does.

entrypoint.description: Path of the entrypoint script, relative to the unit directory.

deps.description: System packages or external repos the unit depends on.
